# Retired legacy workflow templates

The Snyk template failed because no Snyk credential was configured and included generic container commands unrelated to this static site. The labeler had no label configuration. Advanced CodeQL collided with already-enabled native default CodeQL. These templates are archived outside the active workflow directory for reference; do not copy them back unchanged.

Default CodeQL, the new passing Gitleaks scan, static artifact checks, and the existing Dependabot configuration remain. Any optional third-party scanning service requires a reviewed configuration and appropriate credentials before activation.
